deviations.observed_behavior: READ.json and WRITE.json operation documents accept null for optional fields that plan.schema.json types without null (ObjectRef catalog/schema, row_limit, row_offset, filter, srid_policy, spatial parameters) and read it as absent.
The relational IR sends null for absent optional fields (filter without .where(), ObjectRef catalog/schema) and the reader accepts it as absent, although plan.schema.json does not admit null there.
plan::Plan, ReadOperation, WriteOperation and ObjectRef deserialize null as absent in optional fields that plan.schema.json types without null, and serialize absent fields as null.
